title: Orsen and the Ember
author: R. M. Zhou
blurb: Orsen Pemberton, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
